iteration_rule: internal early stopping on train-range days (UTC day % 10 == 0); holdout and forward refit on all train-range rows with iterations x 1.1; test (full 2025) uses the same iterations x 1.1 (--full_mult 1.0) | artmm: p_art cell means moved by kappa x (carrier-month arrival copy share minus its training-month share) where that change is at least 0.10; kappa from training-month cells only; threshold fixed in research | arthist: LIRF non-G p_art moved in log-odds by beta x (flight-history art share vs the flight-month mean p_art); one coefficient beta fitted on the val ruler rows (day folds for val, January for fwd, both months for test)

arthist.model: LIRF non-G rows with p_art > 0: p' = sigmoid(logit p + beta x), x = logit(h) - logit(mean p of the flight in that month), h = flight art share in the training months shrunk 20 rows toward the carrier-route share (itself shrunk 50 rows toward the carrier share); prediction moved by (p' - p)(d - mn) with mn from the corrector's pred and p_art; LOBT window and 0 floor on changed rows; G rows and p_art = 0 rows untouched; the cache files carry p' for the AIU day shift; gkey and later steps go after this
caveats: the hierarchical prior (flight -> carrier-route -> carrier, P1h) was chosen over the carrier-only prior (P1) after both were measured; both won val (day folds), January<->July, July forward and Nov-Dec

the 12-month leave-one-month-out is a label-only proxy against a carrier-level baseline (row-weighted -1.15%, d_sch^2-weighted -2.88%, 12/12 months); the main p_art exists only for the ruler months, so the shift itself was measured on val, fwd and nd
beta is fitted on the val ruler rows (day folds for val, January for fwd, both months for test), the way the A3 corrector's stage 2 is fitted
the history uses 2025 departure labels of the training months; 2026 flights with little 2025 history fall back to the carrier-route and carrier shares

after seeing that about 40% of the test move sits on a dozen rare-carrier rows, a variant that also shrinks the carrier share toward the LIRF share was measured and lost all four rulers (val -33, Jan<->Jul -29, fwd +6, Nov-Dec -36 against -45, -40, -21, -51); kept as built
by month the gain is July (val -42 to -45, fwd -21) and Nov-Dec (-21, -30); January is flat (+2.0 to +2.3); within val July one carrier-month (WMT) carries about two thirds
